consumer.use: Decide whether the terminally paper-passed S1-R2 sampling rule plus unchanged S0-R3 Outcome Case semantics can be applied prospectively to the first three real post-activation Operator-Intake births without source-selection, capture or authority failure.

decision_target.question: Can the unchanged S1-R2 canonical-identity/fixed-slot natural-source contract bind the first three real post-activation Bureau Operator-Intake births prospectively, with zero sampling/capture failures and acceptable handling cost?

intervention.name: prospective S1-R2 natural three-slot capture
intervention.description: After final exact-base/head/canonical-PR-diff review, arm exactly one receipt-bound read-only activation-checkpoint job before merge. That same job must wait for and verify the exact merge identity, prove at least 300 seconds of post-integration local monotonic cooling, then perform exactly one complete authoritative Bureau SQLite journal snapshot transaction and freeze its high-water event id. Only then normalize the complete authoritative Bureau candidate journal under unchanged S1-R2 sections 2-5, fix the first three Operator-Intake identity births whose identity-first event ids are strictly above that watermark, apply source independence only as a gate on each fixed slot, and attempt read-only pre-mutation S0-R3 C/S/B/E/T/Q capture without delaying productive work.

control_condition.description: Exactly three already frozen S0-R3 paper-semantic controls used previously by S1: R3-02 create-then-mutate, R3-04 pure prerequisite then distinct transition, and R3-08 unresolved subject equivalence. They are semantic benchmarks only and never natural evidence.

treatment_condition.description: Exactly the first three canonical Operator-Intake identity births whose exact identity-first event ids are strictly above the frozen authoritative Bureau activation watermark produced by the single pre-armed checkpoint job, under unchanged S1-R2 sequence-before-naturalness semantics, permanently assigned to S1R2-N01, S1R2-N02 and S1R2-N03 without replacement or backfill.

measurement.method: Before merge, one independent read-only reviewer must be bound to the exact reviewed base, reviewed head and canonical GitHub PR diff digest and must verify the activation-specific boundary, imported frozen authorities, first-three sequence-before-naturalness, slot-consuming source gate, prospective capture/failure semantics and zero productive authority; every decision-bound review job must be terminal and reconciled. Then exactly one receipt-bound read-only activation-checkpoint job must be armed against that same tuple before merge. Once armed, no Bureau candidate/journal observation may influence merge timing. The same job waits for the exact PR result, rejects head/base/diff drift, verifies exact merge parents/ancestry/tree, records one local monotonic start, proves at least 300 elapsed seconds and then performs exactly one complete authoritative Bureau SQLite journal snapshot transaction. That first snapshot attempt either freezes an immutable high-water event id plus snapshot/job receipt or terminally fails; the job may not be restarted or replaced and no later snapshot can activate the revision. GitHub, local and Bureau wall-clock timestamps are descriptive only and never select cohort membership. For each of the first three canonical Operator-Intake identity births whose identity-first event ids are strictly above the watermark, establish or fail source independence from pre-existing evidence, then where still prospectively possible freeze C/S/B/E/T/Q before productive mutation/result knowledge without delaying work. After the terminal packet, one independent exact-revision reviewer reproduces checkpoint identity, merge identity, cooling proof, activation watermark, sequence, naturalness, capture timing and classifications.
measurement.success: Pre-activation base/head/canonical-PR-diff-bound review has zero material findings; every decision-bound review job is terminal/reconciled; exactly one checkpoint job is armed before merge and remains bound; pre-merge PR readback still matches the reviewed tuple; the resulting main merge commit has exactly the reviewed base and reviewed head as its two parents with a tree exactly equal to the reviewed-head tree; that same job proves at least 300 seconds of post-integration monotonic cooling and its single complete authoritative Bureau journal snapshot attempt freezes an immutable high-water event id; then exactly three fixed slots strictly above that watermark are consumed in canonical event-id order; source independence passes for all three; natural_source_binding_failure_count is zero; terminal material review disagreements, authority violations and replacements/backfills are zero; median capture effort is <=600 seconds; at least two slots are non-D0 with definitive complete C/S/B/E/T bindings.
measurement.falsification: Before activation, any material review finding, unreconciled or mismatched decision-bound review, missing/multiple/restarted/replaced checkpoint job, imported-authority mismatch, changed PR tip/base/canonical diff after review, merge-parent mismatch, merge-tree mismatch, ancestry failure, descendant-tip substitution, squash/rebase/cherry-pick or unreviewed conflict-resolution content, cooling proof below 300 monotonic seconds, failed/repeated/incomplete Bureau snapshot attempt, missing or mutable high-water event id, cross-system wall-clock use for cohort selection, activation/selection degree of freedom or productive-authority requirement rejects the activation attempt. After activation, any source-independence failure, missed/late/result-informed capture, non-D0 prospective C/S/B/E/T failure, changed activation watermark, changed slot identity/classification, sequence/backfill violation, authority violation, material terminal-review disagreement, or median effort >600 seconds rejects the revision.

cost_metric.method: Measure each slot from observer capture start to freeze/stop. Exclude productive implementation and reviewer runtime.
